messages:
maya: Heads-up — opened a small PR to improve the Optimize toolkit docs: batching + caching + quant profiles. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482
noah: Thanks — can you add a concise migration snippet for teams moving from legacy batching to continuous batching? A one-liner example is enough.
maya: Yup, planning to add python + node SDK examples and a migration note. Draft snippet below:
```python
# enable continuous batching
client = RedwoodClient()
route = client.create_route('gpt-4o', batching={'mode':'continuous','max_batch_size':32, 'latency_slo_ms':200})
```
alek: small nit: use `Redwood()` in JS SDK example, and show `batchingPolicy` key.
alek: here's a quick Node snippet we can paste:
```js
// example: continuous batching
const client = new Redwood({apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY});
await client.routes.create({model: 'gpt-4o', batchingPolicy:{mode:'continuous',maxBatchSize:32,latencySloMs:200}})
```
samir: link checker failed on quant profiles anchor `#quant-profiles` — causes CI fail in site build. I updated the anchor in the PR.
maya: thx @samir — pushed fix. Also added an inline table with recommended quant profiles by model class. Keeping it short.
noah: Could you add a quick note about tradeoffs: fp16 vs int8 quant — one sentence each + when to prefer. And put SDK examples in a collapsible section.
maya: done — added bullets and a collapsible code block, and added a tiny graph image placeholder (assets/opt/quant-tradeoffs.svg) — lmk if image ok.
alek: approve from me for docs style. One more ask: add a short example showing prefix/KV caching config (how to set cache TTL and prefix keys) — customers ask this a lot.
maya: added KV caching snippet:
```yaml
caching:
  kv_cache:
    enabled: true
    ttl_seconds: 3600
    prefix_mode: 'conversation'
```
noah: perfect. I ran the link check locally — all green. :white_check_mark: Please squash and merge when CI passes.
docs-bot: Link check failed initially (1 broken anchor) — rerun complete, 0 failures.
maya: merging now. thanks all :rocket:
alek: would be great to also add a short migration note for Dedicated customers where rolling changes need canary deploys — but that can be follow-up.
maya: noted — will open a follow-up PR with canary/runbook snippets.
noah: thanks team!
